Lithuania to Build Hardened Energy Substation Near Russia

Lithuania is planning to construct a key energy substation near Russia's border. The substation will be fortified against explosive drones, reflecting concerns about the increasing targeting of energy grids. This development comes as energy infrastructure faces growing threats.
